items.author: Trump
items.text: “I’m going to fight and get all of the President’s Nominees confirmed. Get the Permitting Bill passed. I want to do a Reconciliation Bill, which we can pass with no Democrat votes, provide money for the Military, money for Air Control, a Bill to ban Stock Trading, pass a Bill on Pardon Brokers, pass a Fraud Bill, all in the next 50 days. The FAA Funding should be a stand alone Bill — We should get Democrat support for that!” Senator John Kennedy
items.summary_cn: 特朗普转述参议员约翰·肯尼迪的立法计划，涉及空管拨款、许可法案、军事及和解法案以及禁止国会议员炒股。

items.author: Musk
items.text: What Elon Musk’s SpaceX Starship Catch Means for Moon Missions
items.summary_cn: 据报道，SpaceX捕获Starship上面级的技术突破可能进一步改善其月球任务能力。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The Biden Administration was an FAA disaster. Everything they touched turned bad. Big money spent unwisely, making an old and broken system worse than when they began. We have the knowledge and plan for the Flight Control Systems, we need Congress to give the money, FAST! Our FAA is doing a great job, and is ready to go. President DJT https://justthenews.com/government/federal-agencies/trump-admin-rips-biden-admin-handling-air-traffic-control-after-faa
items.summary_cn: 特朗普要求国会尽快批准空管系统资金，并称现有FAA基础设施老化、亟需一次性升级。

items.author: 洪灏

items.author: Trump
items.text: Has anyone noticed that immediately after the Election the Stock Market lost 3 Trillion Dollars in Value? In other words, Investors throughout the World hated seeing what took place on Election Day. But have no fear, the Market has since gone up, and America will soon be GREATER THAN EVER BEFORE! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普声称美国大选后股市一度蒸发3万亿美元，但随后已回升。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Gridlock looms on congressional stock trade ban as parties clash over divestment
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国国会两党因国会议员持股是否应强制出售而分歧，股票交易禁令面临僵局。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am working with Senator Tim Scott and, believe it or not, Senator Adam Schiff, and, additionally, Senators John Cornyn, Raphael Warnock, Steve Daines, Bernie Moreno, Tim Sheehy, Alex Padilla, Mark Warner, Thom Tillis, Chris Coons, Katie Britt, and Dick Durbin, together with Representatives Jason Smith, Nathaniel Moran, Brian Jack, Linda Sanchez, and many others, both Republican and Democrat, on the Motion Picture, Television, and Entertainment Revitalization Act. The support and popularity of doing this, and bringing Entertainment back to the United States of America, has been unbelievable!
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称正推动跨党派支持《影视娱乐振兴法案》，以促进美国影视娱乐业发展。
